title: fv_wo_draft
description: Draft maintenance work order derived from one fault photo plus the CONTEXT line. Contains no ids of any kind — the app decides which asset the work order is raised against.

subject.description: Imperative one-line summary of the work required. Bound restated because string length limits are not preserved server-side: at most 80 characters. No asset ids, no work order numbers, no 'Work Order:' prefix.

description.description: 2 to 4 sentences: what is visible in the photo, the suspected cause, the suggested first action. Reuses the CONTEXT wording for site / space / asset when CONTEXT is given. States plainly when no fault is evident or no photo was available.

priority.description: High only for a hazard or stoppage visible in the photo; Medium for a real defect degrading service; Low for cosmetic wear, no evident fault, or no photo.

tasks.description: 2 to 5 short imperative checklist steps for THIS fault, ordered make-safe first. Inspection steps when no fault is evident. No generic filler.
